title: Clean Minimal Beige Light Mode
concept: Ashgrove, a fictional esports club that "trains quietly so it can play loud": warm beige shells, a framed hero with match/player/ethos cards, a four-step tryout process grid, a training-week app shell, roster, bento and FAQ.
notes: Photos are Unsplash hot-links, warmed slightly with a CSS sepia/saturation filter. Motion is masked headline rise, scroll fade-ins and a slow drifting background wash, all disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
